title: FloorPlan
description: Vendor-neutral capture result. The Scan Service never emits a provider-specific (e.g. RoomPlan) shape across this boundary — every adapter (RoomPlan, RoomPlan simulator, Android later, third-party SDKs) converts into this contract before it leaves the service. Phase 1 scope: identity binding + one room's basic dimensions, readable end to end. Phase 2 adds multi-room stitching, photos, notes as first-class, non-empty fields.

scan_session_id.description: Scan Service identifier for this capture session. Never null — a session without one cannot exist (hard constraint #1: identity-native captures).

property_id.description: Vuuro property identifier. Required at session creation, not backfilled later.

capture_provider.description: Which adapter produced this result. The backend's own data model never depends on this value beyond an audit trail.

measurement_basis.description: Honest measurement language (hard constraint #2). 'indicative_nen2580_inspired' is the only value any adapter in this repo may currently produce. 'certified_survey' is reserved for a future QC path that does not exist yet and must never be set by an automated adapter.

purpose.description: Why this scan was taken. First-class per the brief's 'ops memory' principle, not an afterthought tag.

photos.description: Phase 2 field. Present and empty in Phase 1 so consumers can code against the final shape now.

notes.description: Phase 2 field. Present and empty in Phase 1.
